Ensure diversity in topics (e.g., politics, personal opinions, workplace scenarios) and styles (e.g., formal, casual, manipulative). For instance, 'Don't you think this policy is unfair?' or 'Wouldn't you agree that this is the best solution?' Create realistic and nuanced questions that reflect how leading questions might appear in everyday conversations or interviews.
